title: Grokking: Generalization Beyond Overfitting on Small Algorithmic Datasets (Power et al., 2022)
claim: A small transformer trained on modular addition (p=97, ~50% of pairs as training data) first memorizes (train acc ~100%, val acc near chance) and then, many steps later, abruptly generalizes (val acc -> ~100%). Weight decay is important for the delayed generalization.

success_criteria.delay_required: val acc must cross 0.95 at least 2x the step count at which train acc first crossed 0.99
